topic: Dwell time metric clarification for client
summary_markdown: A discussion occurred regarding the metrics requested by a client (Prowantage). The client requested two specific dwell time metrics: 'Daily Network Average Dwell Time' and 'Daily Average Dwell Time in front of screen'. It was clarified that these likely represent separate clusters of dwell time data—one based on network activity and one specifically for screen viewing. [me] confirmed that this type of data separation is theoretically available.
decisions: The required metrics are understood to be two distinct cluster measurements: Network Dwell Time and Screen Dwell Time.
action_items: Determine the feasibility and method for providing the requested separated dwell time metrics.
